evidence.quote:
She had defined his own trade to a nicety. There might
      be detectives whose work was above this reproach, but he was a confirmed
      creeper, and he knew it.
evidence.paraphrase: Henry is dismayed when Alice's criticism of detective work matches his own sense of his job.

evidence.quote:
It was a stunning blow. If there was one thing on which Henry prided
      himself it was the impenetrability of his disguises.
evidence.paraphrase: Henry is shocked to learn the company saw through all his disguises.

evidence.quote:
If I simply said he
      was a detective, and let it go at that, I should be obtaining the reader's
      interest under false pretences. He was really only a sort of detective, a
      species of sleuth.
evidence.paraphrase: The narrator directly addresses the reader to contrast Henry with a real detective.

evidence.quote:
As a
      sleuth you are poor. You couldn't detect a bass-drum in a telephone-booth.
      You have no future. You are merely among those present. But as a mascot\u2014my
      boy, you're the only thing in sight.
evidence.paraphrase: Jelliffe proposes that Henry change professions from detective to stage mascot.

evidence.quote: 'Don't go,' he said. 'Don't go. I'll let you know now.'
evidence.paraphrase: Prompted by a vision of Alice, Henry immediately decides to accept the stage career.
